snippet.title: Thornhold - Itch.io Prototype - Free Browser Roguelike Autobattler
snippet.description:
Thornhold is free to play in your browser on itch.io!
https://chaostheorygames.itch.io/thornhold

Thornhold is a free roguelike autobattler where you route a river through a forest to power your defenses. Draft cards, place structures and troops, and survive waves of lumber-hungry orcs with seasonal terrain bonuses that rotate mid-run.

📰 Follow development:
LinkTree (all socials): https://linktr.ee/chaostheorygames
Studio: https://chaostheorygames.com
